content: University engineering lab-report guides converge on: title/metadata, objective, theory/background, equipment/BOM with model+serial, procedure, results/measurements, analysis/error discussion, conclusions, references. IEEE citation format is common; BOM and safety checklists appear in hardware-oriented guides; requirements traceability matrices come from systems engineering (FAA VRTM, ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148) and map requirement -> artifact -> verification method (analysis/demonstration/inspection/test) -> result. Uncertainty should be reported with units, absolute and relative error, one significant figure for uncertainty, and a stated confidence basis.
